output.reason: The release note [ev-f8c0f22ce8f2] is only a commit title. PR #22095 [ev-4f27c9833e1b] adds the subject and the change: the application controller should now reset `SelfHealAttemptsCount` when a new revision is available, or when the same revision has already synced successfully. Neither excerpt says what the unreset counter did to applications before the fix (for example, growing self-heal backoff or self-heal stopping), so the consequence can't be typed. They also don't say which applications are exposed, beyond the counter's name hinting at self-heal. The linked issue #21599, which would describe the symptom, is not shown, and the changed-files list [ev-a02e4cd21a7a] only names controller/appcontroller.go and controller/appcontroller_test.go.
